notes: The frame's *that* sits on the apodosis waw s008 rather than on הָיָה, per rule 45's second case.
בִּן הַכּוֹת is split rather than fused: the ASV spends *be worthy* on the construct and *to be beaten* on the infinitive, so each morpheme has a rendering of its own (rules 2, 30).
לְפָנָיו is split because the ASV writes *before*, *face* and *his* — one word per morpheme — so rule 30's one-rendering condition is unmet.
